R7BB-moose-drive-0003.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).

evidence.t: 14 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 28.6 ha, right here.
Burn from 2023 (fire G80280), right here: browse.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

seasonRows.notes: MU 7-45 is not listed in the Region 7B moose rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from District of Hudsons Hope, about 178 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Beryl Prairie Rd, unsigned, Beryl Prairie FSR, Haystack FSR.
Park: 57.1986, -121.36639, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 190 m NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, season: VERIFY. Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip). Also: black bear (see evidence).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-45, Region 7B. Season: no general open season (synopsis page 62, 95%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BB-moose-drive-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-45: about 1,292 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.21 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.2 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
